Not just made. Made with love.

Every piece here is crocheted by hand, one loop at a time. That means small differences from piece to piece, and a lot of patience in each stitch. We think that’s what makes a handmade thing worth keeping.

Pins for your bag, ties for your hair, little charms for your keys. Small things that make a day feel a bit softer.
